# `Q-2-27` — Line Break Before Shortcode Close

> A `{{{< … >}}}` shortcode contains a line break immediately
> before its closing `>}}`.

## What this means

Quarto shortcodes are single-line constructs. The closing `>}}`
must appear on the same line as the rest of the shortcode body.
This error fires when a newline sits between the last argument
and the closing delimiter.

## Why this happens

A long shortcode line that someone wrapped across multiple lines
for readability, or a copy-paste that introduced a line break
before the closer.

## How to fix

Collapse the shortcode onto a single line:

```{.markdown shortcodes="false"}
{{< hello world >}}
```

If the content really needs to span multiple lines, use a
different mechanism — shortcodes are not the right tool.

## Example

```{.markdown shortcodes="false"}
{{< hello
>}}
```
